projectTitle: SMMA Architecture: Website Redesign & CMS Integration
project_haiku:
Form follows digital function
Spaces rendered in pixels
Architecture awakens online
project_footer_CTA: Ready to showcase your architectural vision through stunning digital experiences? Let's build platforms that bring designs to life.
pageSummary:
Client Overview

SMMA (Symmes Maini & McKee Associates) is a renowned multidisciplinary architecture and engineering firm recognized for its innovative design solutions across various sectors, including education, corporate, healthcare, and life sciences. SMMA has built a prestigious reputation through its commitment to sustainability, creativity, and cutting-edge technology in the built environment.

Project Overview

Knectar partnered with the distinguished design agency Toky to deliver a comprehensive website redesign and CMS implementation for SMMA. This collaborative effort resulted in a modern, engaging digital platform built on WordPress and Elementor, leveraging Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), HubSpot integration, SmashBalloon for social media embedding, Tinify API for optimized image compression, Gravity Forms for interactive user forms, and Real Media Library for organized asset management.

Objectives

  • Deliver a visually compelling and highly functional website aligned with SMMA's brand identity.
  • Ensure ease of content management through flexible and robust CMS capabilities.
  • Optimize site performance through integrated image compression and responsive design.
  • Facilitate seamless integration with CRM tools and social media platforms.

Design & Development

Utilizing design frameworks provided by Toky via Figma, Knectar translated sophisticated visual concepts into responsive and interactive web experiences. Key design components included:

  • Render to Reality Blocks: Interactive before-and-after showcases highlighting SMMA's projects.
  • Image & Story Blocks: Engaging visual storytelling components enhanced with embedded multimedia content.
  • Dynamic Media Galleries: Leveraging Elementor and Advanced Custom Fields to create intuitive galleries and carousels.
  • Accordion and Quote Blocks: Enhancing user engagement and information accessibility through interactive content features.

Technical Highlights

  • CMS Framework: WordPress + Elementor enabled SMMA's internal team to manage and update content seamlessly. Extensive use of custom fields via Advanced Custom Fields provided precise content structuring.
  • HubSpot Integration: Streamlined marketing and client engagement workflows through seamless form submissions and user data capture.
  • Image Optimization: Tinify API facilitated automated image compression, significantly enhancing load speed without sacrificing visual quality.
  • Social Media Integration: Implemented SmashBalloon to dynamically populate Instagram feeds, enhancing user engagement and website interactivity.
  • Form Management: Utilized Gravity Forms to deliver gated downloadable content, improving lead generation and user data collection.
  • Asset Management: Real Media Library plugin provided structured asset organization within the WordPress backend, improving content management efficiency.

Outcomes

The redesigned SMMA website successfully captured the firm's innovative and professional image while providing robust, user-friendly content management capabilities. Enhanced performance metrics, improved user engagement, and streamlined internal workflows underscore the project's success.

Conclusion

The collaboration between Knectar and Toky resulted in a powerful, aesthetically appealing, and highly functional digital platform for SMMA, effectively demonstrating the synergy of strategic design and advanced technical implementation.
